requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build is one part only: piece:0,0,0;half-n at q=0,r=0,level=0. No neighboring bases (find_sockets piece offers are all empty at q+/-1,r+/-1) and no piece at level 1. No covers, caps or bins added, per "nothing else".

Configurator maximum is 1 drawer per single base. A full base offers 0 drawer sockets; a half-n/s/e/w base offers 1 socket (s224 → drawer:0#0,0#cut on the cut face). Quarter bases offer 0. Notch drawers require two touching bases beside an empty cell, bay drawers require three — both would require adding bases beside the single base, violating the "nothing else added beside" rule and were offered as 0 sockets when checked. Five drawers in one isolated cell is not offered and cannot be placed without breaking MESH_CLASH / SOCKET_OCCUPIED rules.

finish.summary: Placed the single allowed base as half-n with its one drawer (drawer:0#0,0#cut) — the configurator limit for an isolated base. Verified: full/quarter = 0 drawers, half = 1 drawer, notch/bay = 0 without adding neighboring bases which the brief forbids. Five drawers in one solitary base is not possible in Hex Cluster; build left with one drawer and no extra caps/covers to respect “nothing else added.”

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Blank plug
parts.use: Fills an insert recess you are not using, so the face reads flat and the pocket stays clean.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Foot
parts.use: Snaps onto a stud to give the face something to stand on, so a cell can rest on its cover rather than on its rim.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
